units.source_text: 且说那个年幼的紫姬，进二条院后，日渐驯顺，性情温良，容姿端雅，

en.t: Now young Lady Murasaki, after entering the Nijo estate, grew more obedient day by day, with a gentle nature and graceful bearing,

units.source_text: 只管天真烂漫地亲昵源氏公子。

en.t: and she innocently and artlessly became attached to Prince Genji.

units.source_text: 源氏公子对自己殿内的人，也暂不说明她是何等样人。

en.t: Prince Genji did not yet explain even to the people in his own residence what sort of person she was.

units.source_text: 他一直让她住在与正殿不相连的西殿中，

en.t: He kept her living in the western wing, which was not connected to the main hall,

units.source_text: 而在其中设备高贵无比的种种用具。

en.t: and furnished it with all kinds of incomparably elegant appointments.

units.source_text: 他自己也晨夕过访，教她学习种种技艺，

en.t: He himself visited morning and evening, teaching her to learn various accomplishments,

units.source_text: 例如写了范本教她学习书法等等，

en.t: such as writing models for her and teaching her calligraphy.

units.source_text: 宛如将一向寄居在外的一个亲生女儿迎回家里来了。

en.t: It was as though he had brought home a true daughter who had long been living elsewhere.

units.source_text: 他吩咐上下一切供奉人等，要特别用心服侍紫姬，

en.t: He ordered all the attendants, high and low, to serve Lady Murasaki with particular care,

units.source_text: 务求毫无缺憾。

en.t: making sure that nothing at all was lacking.

units.source_text: 因此除了惟光以外，所有的人都莫名其妙，

en.t: As a result, everyone except Koremitsu was bewildered,

units.source_text: 不知道这女孩是何等样人。

en.t: not knowing what sort of girl she was.

units.source_text: 紫姬的父亲兵部卿亲王也不悉紫姬下落。

en.t: Lady Murasaki's father, Prince Hyobukyo, also did not know where she was.

units.source_text: 紫姬至今还时时回忆往昔，常常追慕已故的尼姑外祖母。

en.t: Lady Murasaki still often recalled the past and constantly longed for her late grandmother, the nun.

units.source_text: 源氏公子在家之时，她心有所专，忧思浑忘。

en.t: When Prince Genji was at home, her heart had something to cling to, and she forgot all her sorrow.

units.source_text: 但到了晚间，虽然公子有时宿在家里，

en.t: But when evening came, although the prince sometimes stayed overnight at home,

units.source_text: 只因忙于各处幽会，不免常作夜游。

en.t: he was busy with secret meetings here and there, and so he often went out at night.

units.source_text: 每逢公子乘夜出门，紫姬总是依依不舍，公子觉得十分可怜。

en.t: Whenever the prince went out under cover of night, Lady Murasaki was always reluctant to part from him, and he found her deeply pitiable.

units.source_text: 有时公子入宫侍驾，二三日不归，接着又往左大臣家滞留。

en.t: At times the prince entered the palace to serve the emperor and did not return for two or three days, then went on to stay at the Minister of the Left's house.

units.source_text: 紫姬连日孤居独处，闷闷不乐。

en.t: Lady Murasaki spent day after day alone and secluded, sunk in melancholy.

units.source_text: 此时公子不胜怜惜，似觉家里有了一个无母的孤儿，

en.t: At such times the prince felt unbearable pity for her, as though there were a motherless orphan in his house,

units.source_text: 冶游也不得安心了。

en.t: and even his amorous outings no longer left him at ease.

units.source_text: 北山的僧都闻知此种情状，心念紫姬乃一孩子，

en.t: When the bishop of Kitayama heard of these circumstances, he thought to himself that Lady Murasaki was only a child,

units.source_text: 何故如此受宠，颇觉诧异，但也深可庆喜。

en.t: and wondered why she was so favored, yet he also felt it was a matter for deep rejoicing.

units.source_text: 每逢僧都追荐尼姑，举行佛事时，

en.t: Whenever the bishop held memorial rites and Buddhist services for the nun,

units.source_text: 源氏公子必遣使吊慰，厚锡唁仪。

en.t: Prince Genji always sent a messenger with condolences and bestowed generous memorial offerings.
